project.experience.preparationGuardrail: Prepared only. You can edit, reject, or confirm; nothing changes automatically.
project.experience.meaningfulTimelineDet: Confirmed changes, decisions, and learning only. Technical audit activity stays separate.
project.experience.officialSourcesOnly: Approved contract rules and authorized human confirmation only.
project.experience.doesNotChangeProgress: This does not change official progress until approved by the contract rule or an authorized human.
project.experience.recordedSourcesNote: Current document history and recorded sources. External links remain untrusted until reviewed.
project.experience.noRecordedSources: No recorded sources in this document version.
project.experience.criteriaContractDetai: How the approved Project document becomes measurable criteria without automatic approval.
project.experience.criteriaContractGuard: AI may prepare a draft from the approved document. Only an authorized human can edit, approve, and activate it.
project.experience.preparedGuardrail: Prepared context only. Nothing is published, approved, or counted as Project progress until the authorized human confirms it.
project.assistant.label: ASK THIS PROJECT
project.assistant.title: Project Assistant
project.assistant.description: Ask a focused question grounded in this Project's authorized sources.
project.assistant.unavailable: Project assistance is unavailable. Try again without changing any Project data.
project.assistant.guardrail: Explains only. It cannot approve work, rate employees, or change Project progress.
review.title: Review before confirming
review.subtitle: Nothing becomes shared work, evidence, or Project progress until you confirm the relevant action.
review.editEvidenceFirst: Edit the suggested evidence first, then select it.
review.progressRemains: Project progress remains unchanged until owner confirmation.
review.progressDeferred: The progress proposal remains a draft. No owner-confirmation command was available, so official Project progress did not change.
review.progressSent: The selected Update recorded a progress proposal for the Project owner. Official Project progress is unchanged until the approved rule and owner confirmation are satisfied.
review.protectionCopy: AI never rates or ranks employees. Project progress never comes from Task count, GitHub volume, or activity frequency. Human confirmation remains mandatory.
review.recovery: Confirmation did not finish. Your edits remain available; review the result and retry only the failed action.
